bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to education; appropriating money for school system videos.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION.

Subdivision 1.

Department of Education.

The sum indicated in this section is appropriated from the general fund to the Department of Education in the fiscal year designated.

Subd. 2.

School system videos.

(a) For a grant to Cultural Connections:

$

800,000

.....

2026

(b) The grant recipient must use grant money to provide at least 320 public middle and high schools with videos explaining our school system to immigrant students and their parents at a basic level to accelerate integration, promote student success, and narrow the knowledge and achievement gaps for students through parental involvement.

(c) The grant recipient must provide videos translated into immigrant parents' first language and provide instructions for distribution to each secondary school receiving the videos.

(d) This is a onetime appropriation.
additions: The sum indicated in this section is appropriated from the general fund to the Department of Education in the fiscal year designated.
(a) For a grant to Cultural Connections:

(b) The grant recipient must use grant money to provide at least 320 public middle and high schools with videos explaining our school system to immigrant students and their parents at a basic level to accelerate integration, promote student success, and narrow the knowledge and achievement gaps for students through parental involvement.
(c) The grant recipient must provide videos translated into immigrant parents' first language and provide instructions for distribution to each secondary school receiving the videos.
